T2_grav_at_A_0_formula:
T2_grav_at_A_0  =  16 * pi * R^4 / (17 * omega_gate)
                ~=  61295.49 / omega_gate   seconds (omega in rad/s)

calibration_correction.correction: T2_grav_at_A_0 = T2_grav_at_horizon / A_0 = T2_grav_at_horizon * pi * R
calibration_correction.name: A_0_OPERATING_POINT_CALIBRATION
calibration_correction.omega_interpretation: omega_gate = the qubit GATE OPERATING angular frequency (NOT the qubit splitting frequency)
calibration_correction.rationale: CR063a v1.0 used omega = qubit splitting frequency at horizon (A = 1).  Real quantum computers operate at the SAM accumulation floor A_0 = 1/(pi*R), not at horizon.  The gravitational coupling scales by A_0, giving 1/A_0 = pi*R enhancement of T2_grav.  Additionally, the relevant omega is the gate operating rate (how often the substrate field responds) rather than the qubit's bare electromagnetic splitting frequency.

forward_blind_test.claim: T2_observed <= T2_grav_at_A_0 = 16 * pi * R^4 / (17 * omega_gate) = 61295.49 / omega_gate seconds, on any qubit platform, with omega_gate as the GATE OPERATING angular frequency.  At-the-limit systems (trapped ions at kHz gates, NV cryogenic with DD) define the maximum achievable T2 in their gate-rate class.
forward_blind_test.falsifier: ONE rigorously-reported peer-reviewed T2 measurement clearly exceeding T2_grav by more than 10x at its gate rate, with non-gravitational decoherence sources fully subtracted, falsifies v1.1.  Specifically: a trapped-ion clock-state T2 measurement clearly above 100 seconds at kHz gate rates would be a hard refutation.
forward_blind_test.non_falsifying: T2 improvements achieved by lowering gate rate (which raises T2_grav proportionally) are CONSISTENT with v1.1.  The falsifier requires exceeding T2_grav at the same omega_gate.

headline_finding.summary: With the A_0 correction, predicted T2_grav floor lies above all 10 published T2 measurements across 4 platform classes.  5 platforms are CONSISTENT (T2_observed < 0.5 * T2_grav); 5 state-of-the-art systems sit AT THE LIMIT (ratio 0.5-2.0); 0 clear VIOLATIONS.
headline_finding.trapped_ion_plateau_prediction: Trapped-ion platforms approaching T2 ~ 10 seconds at typical clock-state gate rates (~1 kHz) are predicted to PLATEAU there under SAM v1.1.  Pushing T2 substantially above this without explanation by reduced gate rates would falsify the gravitational floor.

immutability: T2_grav_at_A_0 formula (16*pi*R^4 / (17*omega_gate)) and trapped-ion plateau prediction are frozen at CR064a seal time.  Future falsification (one platform clearly exceeding T2_grav under rigorous subtraction) or refinement must be in an appeal CR within 12a.

in_sample_verification.consistency_threshold: ratio T2_observed / T2_grav <= 0.5 -> CONSISTENT; 0.5-2.0 -> AT_THE_LIMIT; > 2.0 -> VIOLATION
